slides.title: Vibe Coding: AI-assisted development
slides.subtitle: Building with code, creativity, and Claude
slides.content: A journey through modern development workflows

slides.title: 1) This entire endeavor is steeped with baggage...
slides.content:
• Climate concerns
• Security, ethical access, biases
• Bro idiots gone wild

slides.title: 2) With series of clear reasonable requests, anyone can make something pretty amazing.
slides.content:
• Move by feel, not fear
• Ignore perfection
• Go toward the idea, ignore the code
• Ignore style, unless the point

slides.title: 3) Infinite sandbox (max complexity)...
slides.content:
• No scaffolding necessary
• Anything is plausible
• Chatbot + Canvas (your asset)

slides.title: 4) Iterate.
slides.content:
• Code, preview, tweak
• Save points! (fail, source control)
• Build it many times

slides.title: 5) You are human
slides.content:
• Pause, note the workflow
• Start with fun stuff
• Make it dance
• Just say it

slides.title: 5) Meta documents...
slides.content:
• Readme for AI
• Manifests, guidelines, prompts
• Roadmaps

slides.title: 6) Traditional engineering...
slides.content:
• Separate content from code
• Good variable naming
• Design patterns and thinking ahead
• Order of build
• Careful what you touch
• Borrow good code
• Let go of unused code

slides.title: 7) No eyes, no hands
slides.content:
• Cannot experience your thing
• Cannot use your thing
• Not a human, even though it feels like it

slides.title: 8) Fragile + resilient...
slides.content:
• Every change can generate bugs
• You can make sweeping changes whenever you want
• Context, isolation, microservices

slides.title: 9) Exponential green fields.
slides.content:
• Untested weird ideas, infinite mini apps
• New voices, new perspectives
• Navigate the tsunami

slides.title: 10) Ship it now
slides.content:
• Test with your friends
• Timebox
• This is for testing, no coming soon

slides.title: Timeless Principles, Amplified
slides.content: Whether you're composing music, writing code, or painting—the fundamentals never change. AI just makes them more powerful.

styles.animation: stripeMove 2s linear infinite, textBounce 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate

slides.customCSS: @keyframes stripeMove { from { background-position: 0 0; } to { background-position: 50px 0; } } @keyframes textBounce { from { transform: translateY(0); } to { transform: translateY(-20px); } }

slides.title: The Creative Partnership
slides.content: AI doesn't replace creativity—it amplifies it. Whether you're designing interfaces, composing melodies, or solving algorithms, the magic happens in collaboration. Output debug info and custom admin controls.

styles.background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, #ff006e 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, #8338ec 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #3a86ff 0%, transparent 50%), linear-gradient(45deg, #06ffa5, #ffbe0b)
styles.animation: psychedelic 6s ease-in-out infinite, textGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate

slides.customCSS: @keyframes psychedelic { 0%, 100% { filter: hue-rotate(0deg) saturate(1) brightness(1); } 25% { filter: hue-rotate(90deg) saturate(2) brightness(1.2); } 50% { filter: hue-rotate(180deg) saturate(3) brightness(0.8); } 75% { filter: hue-rotate(270deg) saturate(2) brightness(1.5); } } @keyframes textGlow { from { opacity: 0.9; } to { opacity: 1; } }

slides.title: Embrace the Beautiful Chaos
slides.content: Art thrives in uncertainty. Code evolves through iteration. Both find beauty in experimentation, bold choices, and fearless creation.

styles.animation: megaPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite, gentleSway 4s ease-in-out infinite

slides.customCSS: @keyframes megaPulse { 0%, 100% { filter: brightness(1) contrast(1); } 50% { filter: brightness(2) contrast(2); } } @keyframes gentleSway { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0) scale(1); } 25% { transform: translateX(3px) scale(1.01); } 75% { transform: translateX(-3px) scale(0.99); } }

slides.title: Artists + Technologists = Magic
slides.content: Human creativity + AI capability = unprecedented possibilities. We're not just building apps or making art—we're crafting experiences that move people.

styles.animation: softGlow 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate, gentleBounce 3s ease-in-out infinite

slides.customCSS: @keyframes softGlow { from { filter: brightness(1.5) contrast(2) saturate(3); } to { filter: brightness(2) contrast(2.5) saturate(4); } } @keyframes gentleBounce { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.05); } }

slides.title: From Vision to Reality
slides.content: Ideas flow faster than ever—whether it's a song, an app, or a visual masterpiece. The real skill is knowing when your creation is ready to share with the world.

styles.animation: chaosGrid 0.8s linear infinite, colorMadness 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate, scaleWild 1.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate

slides.customCSS: @keyframes chaosGrid { 0% { background-position: 0 0, 25px 25px, 50px 50px; } 25% { background-position: 25px 0, 0 25px, 25px 75px; } 50% { background-position: 50px 25px, 25px 50px, 0 25px; } 75% { background-position: 25px 50px, 50px 25px, 75px 0; } 100% { background-position: 0 0, 25px 25px, 50px 50px; } } @keyframes colorMadness { from { filter: hue-rotate(0deg) saturate(2) brightness(1.2); } to { filter: hue-rotate(360deg) saturate(4) brightness(1.8); } } @keyframes scaleWild { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); } 33% { transform: scale(1.1) rotate(2deg); } 66% { transform: scale(0.95) rotate(-1deg); } }

slides.title: Perfectionism is Dead
slides.content: Vibe coding kills the paralysis of perfect. Ship the broken thing. Fix it live. Let users find the bugs. The best code is the code that exists, not the code that's perfect.
